svg.aria-label: An osmosis figure: a plant cell in a solution, before and after. Inside the cell: 5% sucrose; outside: 30% sucrose. The solution is hypertonic to the cell. Net water movement out of the cell. The cell loses water and its membrane pulls away from the wall (plasmolysis)
